title: Air Quality and Suicide
abstract: We conduct the first-ever large-scale study of the relationship between air pollution and suicide using detailed cause of death data from all death certificates in the U.S. between 2003 and 2010.Using wind direction as an instrument for daily pollution exposure, we find that a 1 g/m3 increase in daily PM2.5 is associated with a 0.49% increase in daily suicides and 0.171 more suicide-related hospitalizations (a 50% increase).Estimates using 2SLS are larger and more robust, suggesting a bias towards zero arising from measurement error. Event study estimates further illustrate that contemporaneous pollution exposure matters more than exposure to pollution in previous weeks.
abstract_zh: 我们首次利用2003至2010年美国全部死亡证明中的详细死因数据，开展了大规模研究，考察空气污染与自杀之间的关系。以风向作为每日污染暴露的工具变量，我们发现，每日PM2.5每增加1 g/m3，每日自杀人数增加0.49%，与自杀相关的住院人次增加0.171例（增幅为50%）。使用两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）得到的估计值更大、也更稳健，这表明若不考虑测量误差，估计结果会向零偏倚。事件研究估计进一步表明，同期的污染暴露比前几周的污染暴露更为重要。

title: Can Pollution Cause Poverty? The Effects of Pollution on Educational, Health, and Economic Outcomes
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: Although pollution is widespread, there is little evidence about how it might harm children’s long run outcomes. Using the detailed, geocoded data that follows national representative cohorts of children born to the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth respondents over time, I compare siblings who were gestating before versus after a Toxic Release Inventory site opened or closed within one mile of their home. I find that children who were exposed prenatally to industrial pollution have lower wages, are more likely to be in poverty as adults, have fewer years of completed education, and are less likely to graduate high school. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 尽管污染普遍存在，但关于其如何损害儿童长期结局的证据仍然很少。本文利用全国代表性队列数据的详细地理编码信息，这些数据追踪了全国青年纵向调查（National Longitudinal Survey of Youth）受访者所生子女的成长情况。我比较了同一家庭中兄弟姐妹的情况：在有毒物质排放清单（Toxic Release Inventory）设施于其住所一英里范围内开业或关闭之前与之后处于孕期的兄弟姐妹。研究发现，产前暴露于工业污染的儿童成年后工资更低、更可能陷入贫困，完成的受教育年限更少，高中毕业的可能性也更低。国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org上免费下载本文。

title: How (un)Stable Are LLM Occupational Exposure Scores? Evidence from Multi-Model Replication
The Effects of Daily Air Pollution on Students and Teachers
abstract: Recent empirical research shows that air pollution harms student test scores and attendance and increases office discipline referrals. However, the mechanism by which air pollution operates within schools to negatively affect student and teacher outcomes remains largely opaque. The existing literature has primarily focused on the effects of prolonged exposure to pollution on endof-year test scores or total absence counts. We examine how ambient air pollution influences student-by-day and teacher-by-day outcomes, including absences and office discipline referrals, using daily administrative data from a large urban school district in California between 2003 and 2020.Using wind direction as an instrument for daily pollution exposure, we find that a 10 μg/m3 increase in daily PM2.5 causes a 5.7% increase in full-day student absences and a 28% increase in office referrals in a three-day window. Importantly, the effects are driven by low-income, Black, Hispanic, and younger students. In addition, over three days, a 10 μg/m3 increase in daily PM2.5 causes a 13.1% increase in teacher absences due to illness. Our research indicates that decreasing air pollution in urban areas could enhance both student and teacher attendance, and minimize disruptive behavior in educational settings.
abstract_zh: 近期的实证研究表明，空气污染会损害学生的考试成绩和出勤率，并增加办公室纪律处分的次数。然而，空气污染在学校内部对学生和教师结果产生负面影响的机制，在很大程度上仍不清楚。现有文献主要关注长期暴露于污染对学年末考试成绩或缺勤总数的影响。本文利用2003至2020年加州一个大型城市学区的每日行政数据，考察环境空气污染如何影响以学生-日和教师-日为单位的结果，包括缺勤和办公室纪律处分。以风向作为每日污染暴露的工具变量，我们发现，每日PM2.5每增加10 μg/m3，学生全天缺勤率上升5.7%，并且在三天窗口内办公室纪律处分上升28%。重要的是，上述效应主要由低收入学生、黑人学生、西语裔学生以及年龄较小的学生所驱动。此外，三天内，每日PM2.5每增加10 μg/m3，教师因病缺勤率上升13.1%。我们的研究表明，降低城市地区的空气污染，有助于提高学生和教师的出勤率，并减少教育环境中的扰乱性行为。

title: The Spillover Effects of Pollution: How Exposure to Lead Affects Everyone in the Classroom
Broadband Internet Access, Economic Growth, and Wellbeing
Does Pollution Drive Achievement? The Effect of Traffic Pollution on Academic Performance
abstract: We examine the effect of school traffic pollution on student outcomes by leveraging variation in wind patterns for schools the same distance from major highways. We compare within-student achievement for students transitioning between schools near highways, where one school has had greater levels of pollution because it is downwind of a highway. Students who move from an elementary/middle school that feeds into a "downwind" middle/high school in the same zip code experience decreases in test scores, more behavioral incidents, and more absences, relative to when they transition to an upwind school. Even within zip codes, microclimates can contribute to inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们利用与主要高速公路距离相同的学校之间风向模式的差异，考察学校交通污染对学生结果的影响。我们比较了在靠近高速公路的学校之间转学的学生的个人成绩变化，其中一所学校因位于高速公路下风向而污染水平更高。与转入上风向学校相比，从一所“下风向”小学/初中转入同一邮政编码区内、与其对接的初中/高中的学生，其考试成绩下降，行为违纪事件增多，缺勤次数也增加。即使在同一邮政编码区内，微气候也可能加剧不平等。
